summary: Standard Lithium Ltd. filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing successful downstream battery testing of lithium carbonate from its South West Arkansas Project. Nano One used the lithium carbonate to manufacture LFP cathode active material and coin cells, achieving ~155 mAh/g on first discharge. This is routine operational and technical progress disclosure, not a special situation. No M&A, restructuring, capital markets, or strategic corporate event is involved. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer update on project development and supply chain validation, with no deal terms or transaction implications.
